`native-entry.bin` and `native-pack.msgpack` are golden fixtures from the real
Olric v0.7.4 default engine.

`native-run-pack.msgpack` uses that entry at offset zero, hash 42, in a native
Pack with Allocated=1MiB, State=2, Offset=Inuse=43 and zero garbage. Its bitmap
was generated by Roaring v1.9.4: add offsets [0,64), RunOptimize, then Remove
1 through 63 individually. Roaring retains a run container containing offset
zero (cookie 12347), without overlapping records. Both engines import the pack;
the custom export is imported back by the real default engine.
